components.name: Primary Button (Stamp Action)
components.description: Brand-gold primary action with dark ink; on the stamp card it is full-width, size lg, and state-coupled (label = the one legal stamp action).
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: var(--color-accent, #e1b025); color: #231a02; font-family: Figtree, sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 15px; padding: 12px 24px; border: none; border-radius: 0.625rem; width: 100%; cursor: pointer; transition: filter 125ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { filter: brightness(0.96); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #b9900e; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Bordered neutral for the demoted alternative action (Pause starten, banner actions).

components.name: Status Dots
components.description: Accent dot is brand gold (eingestempelt, pulsing live); warning is orange; neutral is mid-gray. Dot fills match filled badge colors.
components.html: Eingestempelt Pause Ausgestempelt
components.css: .ds-dotrow { font-family: Figtree, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; color: #67625a; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; } .ds-dot { inline-size: 8px; block-size: 8px; border-radius: 9999px; display: inline-block; } .ds-dot-gold { background: #e1b025; } .ds-dot-orange { background: #e97a00; } .ds-dot-neutral { background: #737373; }

components.name: Timeline Segments (Arbeit / Pause)
components.description: The signature grammar: gold filled block with shadow for Arbeit, flat dashed muted block for Pause; open segments gradient toward white with a breathing live tip.
components.css: .ds-tl { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; inline-size: 260px; font-family: Figtree, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-tl-arbeit { position: relative; display: flex; justify-content: space-between; padding: 8px 12px; border-radius: 0.625rem; background: #e1b025; color: #231a02; font-weight: 600; box-shadow: 0 2px 4px oklch(0 0 0 / 5%), 0 4px 8px oklch(0 0 0 / 10%); overflow: hidden; } .ds-tl-offen { background: linear-gradient(180deg, #e1b025 0%, color-mix(in srgb, #e1b025 78%, white) 100%); } .ds-tl-pause { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; padding: 8px 12px; border-radius: 0.625rem; background: #f5f2ea; color: #67625a; border: 1px dashed #d8d2c6; } .ds-tl-tip { position: absolute; inset-inline: 0; inset-block-end: 0; block-size: 5px; background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, rgba(255,255,255,0.85), transparent); animation: ds-atmen 2.6s ease-in-out infinite; } @keyframes ds-atmen { 0%, 100% { opacity: 0.25; } 50% { opacity: 0.9; } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-tl-tip { animation: none; opacity: 0.6; } }

components.name: Mini-Timeline
components.description: A day compressed into one horizontal pill band for team rows: gold = Arbeit, pause-stone = Pause, bronze tick = now.
components.css: .ds-mini { position: relative; display: block; inline-size: 240px; block-size: 16px; background: #f5f2ea; border-radius: 9999px; overflow: hidden; } .ds-mini > span { position: absolute; top: 0; bottom: 0; } .ds-mini-arbeit { background: #e1b025; } .ds-mini-pause { background: #8b8474; } .ds-mini-now { width: 2px; background: #7c5f05; }

narrative.overview: The workday itself is the interface. Instead of a form beside a stats grid, the employee's day is rendered as a live vertical timeline that stamping writes onto: gold blocks are worked time, quiet dashed gaps are breaks, and a bronze now-line crawls down as the clock runs. Every other surface in the app is a restatement of that same timeline grammar at a different scale — a horizontal mini-band per team member, quiet week bars against a Soll tick. The world is warm and papery, not clinical: white cards float on a barely-warm paper body with warm stone neutrals, so the single brand color — MedArbeiter gold #e1b025 — can mean exactly one thing. Gold is worked time and the primary action; it is never decoration and never a status color. The tone is calm, trustworthy, and payroll-serious: tabular numerals everywhere times appear, one authored motion moment, German-only voice. Built on Astryx components with the MedArbeiter theme; light mode is forced at the provider, so the shipped world is exclusively the light palette.
keyCharacteristics: One accent, one meaning: gold = Arbeit + primary action, nothing else.
Warm stone neutrals on a paper ground (#faf8f3 body, white surfaces), never cold gray.
Timeline grammar repeated at three scales (day, mini-band, week bars).
Poppins headings (wordmark kinship), Figtree body, tabular numerals for all times.
Quiet motion: one breathing live-tip; everything else is fast, functional transitions.

rules.name: The Gold-Is-Work Rule
rules.body: Brand gold #e1b025 appears only as worked time and the primary action. No status color, chart color, or decoration may use gold or yellow; warnings are orange. If something is gold, it is work.

rules.name: The Dark-Ink-On-Gold Rule
rules.body: Text or icons on a gold surface are always #231a02. White on gold fails AA and is forbidden.

rules.name: The Three-Golds Rule
rules.body: Gold degrades by duty, not by taste: fill #e1b025, text/now-line bronze #7c5f05 (icons #8f6e06), focus/selected #b9900e. Never use fill-gold at text size or bronze as a fill.

rules.name: The Tabular Time Rule
rules.body: Every time or duration — axis labels, segment ranges, week totals, the now-pill, Zeitkonto — renders with tabular numerals. Times never wiggle as they tick.

rules.name: The German Voice Rule
rules.body: The UI is German-only (lang=de, locale de). Astryx built-in strings are covered by a partial catalog in locales/de.json; any new built-in string an Astryx component surfaces must be added there, never left English.

rules.name: The Duplicate-Don't-Reorder Rule
rules.body: When mobile needs the primary action first, render a second DOM instance gated by .nur-mobil/.nur-desktop; never reorder with CSS alone.

rules.name: The Work-Casts-A-Shadow Rule
rules.body: On any timeline, only Arbeit lifts (shadow-low); Pause stays flat and dashed. Depth encodes the same meaning as color.

dos: Do paint worked time, the primary action, and the clocked-in StatusDot in brand gold #e1b025 — and nothing else.
Do put dark ink #231a02 on every gold surface, and use bronze #7c5f05 whenever gold must act as text or a thin line.
Do set every time and duration in tabular numerals.
Do keep all copy German and register new Astryx built-in strings in locales/de.json.
Do reuse the timeline grammar (gold = Arbeit, dashed/stone = Pause, bronze now-marker) for any new time visualization, at whatever scale.
Do use .zeile-interaktiv (overlay hover + 2px #b9900e focus outline) for any new clickable row.
donts: Don't use gold or yellow for warnings or any status — warnings are orange (#e97a00 filled / #6e3500 text).
Don't use white text on gold; it fails AA.
Don't ship dark-mode surfaces — the app forces mode="light"; dark token slots are dormant theme inheritance, not a supported mode.
Don't use Astryx FieldLabel's isRequired/isOptional props (hardcoded English).

Don't add a second ambient animation. The breathing live-tip (zeitleiste-atmen, 2.6s, reduced-motion-safe) is the one authored motion moment; everything else is state transitions at fast/medium/slow (125/300/700ms).
Don't reorder mobile layouts with CSS; duplicate the DOM instance under .nur-mobil/.nur-desktop so focus order matches visual order.
